chunks: Ghiyāth ibn Ibrāhīm narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
ʿAlī عليه السلام said: “There is no harm if a woman is not circumcised, but as for a man, it is necessary for him.”

key_terms.فَلَا بُدَّ مِنْهُ: it is unavoidable or necessary for him
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; indicates permissibility or absence of objection

ai.seo_question: Is circumcision necessary for men and women according to this hadith from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal distinction between women and men regarding circumcision. It indicates that circumcision is not required for a woman, whereas for a man it is deemed necessary.
